parts.description:
Groups all parts of a context menu. Composes the Menu primitive but, instead of anchoring the
popup to a trigger element, anchors it to the pointer position captured by `rdxContextMenuTrigger`.

Reuse the Menu popup parts inside it — `rdxMenuPositioner`, `rdxMenuPopup`, `rdxMenuItem`,
`rdxMenuCheckboxItem`, `rdxMenuRadioGroup`, `rdxMenuSubTrigger`, `rdxMenuSeparator`, … all behave
identically here.

inputs.name: open
inputs.description: Whether the menu is currently open.

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Whether interactions with the menu are disabled.

inputs.name: modal
inputs.description:
Whether the menu should block outside interactions and page scrolling.
Nested menus are always non-modal.

inputs.name: loopFocus
inputs.description: Whether keyboard navigation wraps at list boundaries.

inputs.name: highlightItemOnHover
inputs.description: Whether moving the pointer over items should highlight them.

outputs.name: onOpenChange
outputs.description: Emits when the open state changes.

outputs.name: onOpenChangeComplete
outputs.description: Emits after opening or accepted close completion, including a pending external exit.

outputs.name: onItemHighlighted
outputs.description: Emits when the highlighted item changes, including clearing and collection replacement.

parts.description:
An area that opens the context menu on right click (or a touch long-press).

Apply it to the element that should respond to the context-menu gesture; the popup is positioned
at the pointer, not against this element.

inputs.name: longPressDelay
inputs.description: How long (ms) a touch must be held before the menu opens.
